resources.string: Sleep Saver turns the sleep your watch records into a sleep-debt number and a daily energy schedule, and wakes you with the alarms you set. Here is exactly what it touches.

From Health Connect, with your permission: sleep sessions and sleep stages, and, if you allow them, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and steps. Sleep is required; everything else is optional and only used for the Sleep Quality charts. From this phone, only while your alarm\'s surfacing window or the optional movement log runs: the motion sensor, reduced to one movement number per 30 seconds. No microphone. What you enter: marks, Morning feel, Night steps check-offs and Tomorrow lists. What the app records: your alarm history (when it rang, snoozes and stops), when you dropped anchor, and when Hush played.

Nowhere. Everything is stored in a private database on this phone. Sleep Saver has no account, no servers, no analytics and makes no network requests. Your next alarm is also kept in a small file the phone can read before you unlock it after a restart, so it still rings.
Nothing to Health Connect. When you adjust a night, your change is saved inside Sleep Saver next to the original data, so you can always revert it.
You can revoke access at any time in Health Connect settings, export everything as CSV or JSON from Settings, or erase it all with Reset. Uninstalling the app deletes its data.
Sleep Saver is a wellness tool. Its numbers are estimates based on simple models, not a diagnosis. If you are worried about your sleep, talk to a doctor.
